SELECT pd."id", pd.id AS sku_id, pd.images_url, pi.spu_no, pd.sku_no, pd."name", pp.actual_arrival_qty, pp.arrival_state, pi.pirate_risk, pc.retail_price, pd.product_state, pd.create_user_id, pd.create_time, pi.spec_type FROM product_info pi INNER JOIN product_detail pd ON pi.id = pd.product_id LEFT JOIN product_purchase pp ON pp.sku_id = pd."id" LEFT JOIN product_cost pc ON pc.sku_id = pd."id"
AND (pi.spu_no LIKE concat('%',#{params.no},'%') OR pd.sku_no LIKE concat('%',#{params.no},'%'))
AND pd.product_state in
#{state}
ORDER BY pd.create_time DESC

SELECT pi."id", pd.id AS sku_id, pp.id AS purchase_id, pc.id AS cost_id, ps.id AS sale_id, ppk.id AS pack_id, pl.id AS logistics_id FROM product_info pi INNER JOIN product_detail pd ON pi.id = pd.product_id LEFT JOIN product_purchase pp ON pp.sku_id = pd."id" LEFT JOIN product_cost pc ON pc.sku_id = pd."id" LEFT JOIN product_sale ps ON ps.sku_id = pd."id" LEFT JOIN product_pack ppk ON ppk.sku_id = pd."id" LEFT JOIN product_logistics pl ON pl.sku_id = pd."id" WHERE pd.id = #{skuId} LIMIT 1

SELECT pi."id", pd.images_url, pd.sku_no, pd.product_state, pi."name", pi.charge_name, pi.brand_name, pi.property, pi.grade, pi.category, pi.sale_method, pi.sell_spot, pi.product_function_desc, pi.usage_desc, pi.pirate_risk, pi.materials, pd.plan_listing_time, pd.unit_id, pd.product_state FROM product_info pi INNER JOIN product_detail pd on pi.id = pd.product_id WHERE pi.id = #{productId}

SELECT pi."id", pd.images_url, pi.spu_no, pi."name", pi.charge_name, pi.brand_name, pi.property, pi.grade, pi.category, pi.sale_method, pi.sell_spot, pi.product_function_desc, pi.usage_desc, pi.pirate_risk, pi.materials FROM product_info pi INNER JOIN product_detail pd on pi.id = pd.product_id WHERE pi.id = #{productId}
